title: Oven Smoky Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A smoky and dense kid-friendly Algerian dish featuring filo pastry and lamb, made in a ti-leaf wrap, this recipe is low-glycemic-friendly and perfect for a family dinner.
instructions: Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the lamb pieces on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Wrap each piece of lamb in a ti leaf, then wrap in filo pastry, brushing the edges with water to seal.
Place the wrapped lamb pieces in a large baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
